messages:
Sam D: Quick heads-up - PR #8992 has a worked billing example that mixes list vs discounted prices and might confuse readers.
Priya K: Can you paste the exact snippet so we can fix the math?
Sam D: Current doc shows:
```
Request: generate 350 tokens + 2 embeddings
Doc math: generation = 350 * $0.000025 = $0.00875
embeddings = 2 * $0.00035 = $0.00070
Total = $0.00945
```
This misses that this account is on Dedicated reserved capacity where generation gets a discount and token rounding is per-request.
Victor B: Also note the Console groups by SKU; customers may assume a single combined SKU. We should be explicit about meter names: `generation.tokens` and `embeddings.units`.
Jules (docs): Proposed replacement (concise worked example):
```
Worked example (illustrative):
Request: generate 350 tokens + 2 embeddings
List price: generation = 350 * $0.000025 = $0.00875
List price: embeddings = 2 * $0.00035 = $0.00070
List subtotal = $0.00945
Reserved discount (generation only, example 10%): discounted generation = $0.00875 * 0.9 = $0.007875
Total after discount = $0.007875 + $0.00070 = $0.008575 (~$0.00858)
Note: tokens are rounded per request; final billed amounts depend on meter aggregation and rounding.
```
Sam D: Can we add a tiny SDK sample to map request -> meter events?
Jules (docs): Yes, add a short Python snippet and a 3-row matrix saying which discounts typically apply (Hosted: none; Dedicated: generation reserved; Private: contract dependent). Also link the metering glossary.
Sam D: Python snippet I suggest:
```py
# python example
resp = client.responses.create(
  model='rw-instruct-1',
  input='Summarize this',
  embeddings={'model':'rw-embed-1','inputs':['para1','para2']}
)
# Billing emits: generation.tokens -> 350, embeddings.units -> 2
```
Victor B: BillingBot CI: docs/build succeeded (https://ci.internal.redwood/docs/8992) :white_check_mark:
Priya K: One small nit - use a conservative illustrative discount (10%) and explicitly label it "example".
Jules (docs): I'll update the heading to "Mixed-workload billing example", add the SDK snippet, the 3-row matrix, and a pointer to the Console screenshot to avoid SKU confusion.
Sam D: Updated PR with the example and snippet. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8992 :eyes:
Jules (docs): Reviewing now. If CI stays green I'll merge and backport the note to the Billing FAQ. Thanks! :thumbsup:
